answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Work waits on the lagoon until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the inlet of the next round. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, reduced by each unverified claim, rewards vest against future work. By the meadow of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
